summary.motive: Punish light nickel boxes with vertical double-teams ("Duo"), creating massive interior movement and establishing the physical run picture that unlocks play-action shot plays.
summary.whyItWorks: Dual simultaneous double-teams generate relentless vertical push; the running back presses frontside until the Mike commits, then cuts back behind the Center’s interior seal.
summary.failureMode: A dominant 3-tech DT splitting the RG/RT double-team or safety flying down unblocked into the cutback alley before the RB can press the line.

beats.title: 1. Dual Interior Double-Teams
beats.text: The Center and Left Guard combo the 1-tech NT, while Right Guard and Right Tackle combo the 3-tech DT. McVay creates two 600-pound vertical displacements without using a pulling guard ("Power without a puller").

beats.title: 2. The Mesh & Mike Conflict Read
beats.text: The running back tracks downhill directly into the frontside A/B gap, pressing the line of scrimmage to freeze the Mike Linebacker. The QB fakes a weakside bootleg to hold the backside defensive end.

beats.title: 3. The Second-Level Cutback Burst
beats.text: As the Mike overcommits to plug the frontside B-gap, the running back plants his outside foot and bends sharply back into the wide crevasse behind the Center’s displacement on the NT.

beats.title: 4. Explosive Open-Field YAC
beats.text: Slot receiver H pins the Nickel defender with a vicious crack block while the RB bursts through the secondary past the diving Will linebacker for an explosive 15-yard gain.

relations.tell: Offensive line vertical-punch double teams climbing to Mike linebacker; no pulling guard, RB presses interior A-gap mesh.
